note: makeresults events carrying f as a multivalue, an empty string, a plain value and no value; served for the listing of index s2_sentinels sourcetype s2:sentinels on field f
spl: | makeresults count=5 | streamstats count as n | eval f=case(n=1, split("b,a,b", ","), n=2, "", n=3, "x", n=4, split("a,b",",")) | eval matalog_sv=case(isnull('f'), "__missing__", mvcount('f')>1, "__multi__".urldecode("%1F").mvjoin(mvsort(mvdedup('f')), urldecode("%1F")), 'f'=="", "__empty__", true(), 'f') | stats count by matalog_sv | sort 0 -count
